summary.text: Gail Pellerin was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 28th Assembly District.

paragraphs.text: She was the chief elections official in Santa Cruz County from 1993 until her retirement in December 2020, and served as president of the California Association of Clerks and Election Officials from 2010 to 2012.
Pellerin has a B.S. in journalism from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo, and earlier worked as a newspaper reporter and photographer and a community college instructor.
